Class Stdlib

java.lang.Object
org.apache.tomcat.jni.Stdlib
@Deprecated public class Stdlib extends Object
Deprecated.
The scope of the APR/Native Library will be reduced in Tomcat 9.1.x / Tomcat Native 2.x and has been reduced in Tomcat 10.1.x / Tomcat Native 2.x onwards to only include those components required to provide OpenSSL integration with the NIO and NIO2 connectors.
Stdlib.
